surprises.head: Justus Annunen got lit up
surprises.body: Annunen allowed 6 goals on 20 shots, worth 2.2 expected goals: 3.8 more than expected. Starting goalies have a night this rough about once every 125 starts. Most starters don’t get one a season.

story.head: Four points for Eriksson Ek as the Wild beat the Predators
paras: The first period belonged to the Wild. Brock Faber and Blake Coleman scored less than five minutes apart early in the period to put the Wild up 2-0. Maxim Shabanov scored late in the period, and Matt Boldy followed 43 seconds after that to make it 4-0. There were six goals in the second period alone. Boldy struck again on the power play just 59 seconds into the period to make it 5-0. Nicolas Hague got the Predators on the board 53 seconds later, and Marcus Foligno made it 6-1 for the Wild just 17 seconds later. Justus Annunen left the game in the second, and Juuse Saros finished it in net for Nashville. Jonathan Marchessault cut Minnesota’s lead to 6-2 early in the second, in his first game back after missing seven games. Filip Forsberg made it 6-3 late in the period, and Joel Eriksson Ek stretched the lead to 7-3 with just five seconds left in the period. Eriksson Ek finished with four points on a goal and three assists, and Boldy added an assist for a three-point night.

The Wild had a bit more of the good stuff, outshooting the Predators 38-28. The Predators hit a post and the crossbar twice, and the bounces never came. Jesper Wallstedt made 25 saves for the Wild. He has won seven straight starts. Nobody on the ice had a bigger night than Quinn Hughes, by our Swing measure. The Wild moved to 16-3-4, still first in the Central, while the Preds fell to 11-6-5, slipping to fourth in the Central.

items.text: The Wild have points in twelve straight games (10-0-2), the longest run in the league right now.
Joel Eriksson Ek passed Ryan Suter for seventh on the Wild’s all-time scoring list, with 371 points.
Kirill Kaprizov has a point in twelve straight games.
Steven Stamkos extended his point streak against Minnesota to ten games.
